params.body:
The VM on v0.21.0, so a review page fits: the gateway refused Vera's first real publish at 8 MiB, and the armed page is 11.2 MB inside the submission. The release also names an oversized body as a 413 instead of a read error.

Beside the pin, one correction found while in the file: the rehearsal's `AGENT` and `PRINCIPAL` defaults still named the first identifier, `QmdUpq…`, which is final at version 14 since this morning. The carried configuration overrides them on a real boot, so nothing was broken, but a default that names a closed identity is read by exactly one person: whoever rebuilds from `docs/rebuild.md`, at the moment they have the least context to spot it. Both defaults and the one in `rehearse.sh` now name the successor.

After merging: `deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh upgrade`.
params.title: De VM op v0.21.0
